description: Presidential Secretariat - Proclamation for summoned parliament at 9.30 a.m. of 28.04.2017 in order to keep the parliament informed the order of declaration of essential services
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of essential services under the Public Security Ordinance and the summoning of Parliament to be informed of this declaration. This involves the use of statutory powers and legal procedures outlined in an existing ordinance, making it a matter of legal framework and regulatory action. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or electoral matters.
